text:
sam: onboarding Stalwart's LoRA merge to our sandbox now. quickheads: embed recall dropped vs base on customer's FAQ set. starting a quick triage.

ryan: results link https://internal.redwood/quick-evals/1812349999 — embedding cosine delta ~ -0.12 on faq_anchor set :thinking_face: 

lina: saw a tokenization wrinkle, small example below. might explain some embed shifts: 

```
orig: \"Total: €12.50 • due 10/21\"
tokens(base): [502, 1245, 9999, ...]
tokens(stalwart): [502, 1245, 11234, ...]  // extra boundary at price/€
```

maya: FYI we applied OPTQ int4 quant during the merge step. ran a no-quant compare and the drop is ~0.03 (much smaller). quant seems to amplify the delta.

ryan: re-ran locally: base vs merged (no-quant) cosine 0.03, with int4 0.12. so quantization interaction + tokenizer differences = bigger effect.

sam: eval-bot posted smoke run summary: \"embed_recall: 0.86 -> 0.74\", \"generation_ppl: 12.3 -> 12.5\". attaching artifact.

eval-bot: [auto] quickpack results finished: /artifacts/1812349999/quickpack.json — generation thresholds OK; embedding_recall failed (delta -0.12).

lina: propose a quick tokenizer preproc patch: normalize currency symbol -> token that matches adapter training preproc, or add a merge-vocab mapping. adapter may have been trained with a different preproc pipeline.

maya: also check layernorm folding version used during quant. we had two folders in the pipeline (fold-v2.1 vs fold-v2.3) — slight numerical differences can change KV-cache outputs after quant. can someone run the same model with fold-v2.3?

sam: let's get a reproducible repro. run this command and paste the top failing examples: 

```
./run_quick_eval.sh --model stalwart-merge:v2 --quant int4 --dataset cust_faqs --seed 42
```

ryan: running now, ETA ~7m. will post diffs.

(7m later)

ryan: top human-readable diff: 
```
Q: How do I update billing?
base emb top1: \"Go to settings > billing\"
stalwart emb top1: \"Open billing page\"  // semantically same but embedding dist increased
```

maya: that one is tolerable for downstream UX, but reranker uses a hard embedding threshold. options: 1) try int8 quant (bitsandbytes) to see if embedding drift reduces, 2) rebuild adapter with tokenizer mapping so boundaries align, 3) do a small embedding-finetune on customer's FAQ anchors to anchor vectors.

lina: I'll open a PR for tokenizer preproc (normalize currency + bullet map) and add a unit test for the token boundary case. PR link: https://git/repo/pull/1234

ryan: after PR lands I'll re-run quickpack across int4/int8 and record deltas (embedding_recall + reranker passrate).

sam: plan: assemble a quick eval pack that includes embedding recall, reranker passrate, token-boundary unit tests, and a small FAQ anchor fine-tune sim. run on canary once PR merges. target: mitigation plan within 48h. tagging @eng-ml and @customer-success. :thumbsup:

lina: +1. I'll add the token boundary tests to the quickpack and a small sample of numeric/currency cases.

sam: updating ticket INF-442 with this plan and timeline. thanks team.
